note: Site map (permanent page index) — workspaces, landings and advisory edges. Detail (sections/organisms/bffCalls) lives per-workspace under workspaces/.

workspaces.title: Operational Dashboard
workspaces.purpose: Project manager gets a quick overview of all active projects, budget drift, and task urgency.

workspaces.title: Manage Projects
workspaces.purpose: Project manager creates and maintains projects through their full lifecycle.

workspaces.title: Project Detail & Timeline
workspaces.purpose: Project manager reviews the full project detail, timeline, tasks, change orders, costs, and delay-risk insights.

workspaces.title: Change Orders
workspaces.purpose: Project manager documents, edits, and approves change orders, applying cost impact to the job.

workspaces.title: Status Reports
workspaces.purpose: Project manager generates AI-assisted status reports, reviews delay-risk suggestions, and shares reports with clients.

workspaces.title: Client Directory
workspaces.purpose: Project manager maintains the client directory used across projects.

workspaces.title: Task Board
workspaces.purpose: Project manager creates and assigns work tasks; field workers update task status from the field.

workspaces.title: My Tasks
workspaces.purpose: Field worker browses and reviews their assigned tasks for the day.

workspaces.title: Log Time & Materials
workspaces.purpose: Field worker logs hours worked and materials used against active tasks, keeping job costing accurate.

workspaces.title: Job Cost Summary
workspaces.purpose: Billing staff reviews accumulated job costs per project before preparing billing documents.

workspaces.title: Billing Summaries
workspaces.purpose: Billing staff compiles and shares client-facing billing summaries from approved job cost data.

workspaces.title: Invoices
workspaces.purpose: Billing staff generates invoices from approved costs and sends them to clients.

workspaces.title: Project Status
workspaces.purpose: Client reviews the shared project status report to stay informed on progress and budget.

workspaces.title: My Billing
workspaces.purpose: Client reviews billing summaries and invoices shared by billing staff.

landings.reason: Project manager starts their day with the operational dashboard for a full overview of active projects and priorities.
Field worker opens the app to their assigned task list to know what to work on today.
Billing staff starts by reviewing accumulated job costs before preparing billing summaries or invoices.
Client lands on the project status area to review the latest shared status report.
